assets.origin: center of virtual horizontal rod axis
assets.construction: Extrude a closed U-shaped YZ cross-section along X from -0.12 to +0.12. Front leg y=-0.011, back leg y=+0.011 at mid-surface. Legs start at z=0 and run down. Upper fold y=r*cos(t), z=r*sin(t), t=0..pi. Thickness 0.002 normal to cross-section midline; close hem ends and X ends. No subdivision.
